set.seed(1)
sample_nodes = nodes %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 0.2)
sample_edges = edges %>%
  filter(from %in% sample_nodes$node, to %in% sample_nodes$node)

stats = tibble(n_nodes = nrow(sample_nodes), n_edges = nrow(sample_edges)) %>%
  mutate(mean_degree = 2 * n_edges / n_nodes,
         density = 2 * n_edges / (n_nodes * (n_nodes - 1)))
